tuyaopen-embedded-env-setup.en: SDK acquisition, activation, host tools and environment diagnostics; not runtime device diagnosis.
tuyaopen-embedded-env-setup.zh-CN: SDK 获取、初始化、工具链和主机环境诊断；不承担设备运行故障诊断。

tuyaopen-embedded-project.en: Create projects, manage identity/board/PID metadata, browse demos and change IDE settings; build options belong to build.
tuyaopen-embedded-project.zh-CN: 创建工程、维护身份与板卡/PID 绑定、浏览 demo 和 IDE 设置；Kconfig 操作归编译技能。

tuyaopen-embedded-build.en: Compile/clean firmware, edit and verify Kconfig, diagnose compiler/link failures and integrate library sources.
tuyaopen-embedded-build.zh-CN: 编译清理、Kconfig 编辑与生效检查、编译链接故障及第三方源码构建接入。

tuyaopen-embedded-hardware.en: Confirm physical hardware and pin/mux/occupancy evidence; implement board, external and raw peripheral use.
tuyaopen-embedded-hardware.zh-CN: 核对硬件、板卡引出引脚、复用及占用，记录确认结果并实现外设；新增 BSP 另行处理。

tuyaopen-embedded-flash.en: Identify the current image and target board/port, flash or read firmware and explicitly reset hardware.
tuyaopen-embedded-flash.zh-CN: 确认当前固件、目标板与端口，执行烧录、Flash 读回和明确请求的复位；日志和授权另行处理。

tuyaopen-embedded-cli-debug.en: Capture/analyze device logs, drive its actual serial console and decode matching crash images.
tuyaopen-embedded-cli-debug.zh-CN: 设备日志采集分析、串口 CLI 交互及匹配固件的崩溃定位；不承担主机环境初始化。

tuyaopen-embedded-add-board.en: Create an independent board BSP, board registration, Kconfig and application presets in the actual SDK.
tuyaopen-embedded-add-board.zh-CN: 新增独立开发板/BSP、板级注册、Kconfig 和预置配置；既有板应用外设使用归硬件技能。

tuyaopen-embedded-code-check.en: Check changed C/C++ formatting, headers, forbidden characters and sensitive data in SDK or external APP sources.
tuyaopen-embedded-code-check.zh-CN: 检查本次 C/C++ 修改的格式、文件头、字符及敏感信息，支持 SDK 外独立 APP。

tuyaopen-embedded-device-auth.en: Manage local licenses, write/read device credentials and diagnose provisioning and activation separately.
tuyaopen-embedded-device-auth.zh-CN: 管理授权码、设备凭据写入读回，并分别诊断配网、激活、MQTT 和 DP 状态。

tuyaopen-workflow-embedded-dev.en: Coordinate an explicitly multi-stage firmware request, recover progress and hand over measured evidence; not the entry for every single build or log request.
tuyaopen-workflow-embedded-dev.zh-CN: 编排明确的多阶段固件任务、恢复进度和交接证据；单独编译、日志或外设请求直接使用对应任务技能。

tuyaopen-cloud.en: Create/read cloud products and DPs, synchronize and verify the requested schema using declared authenticated capabilities.
tuyaopen-cloud.zh-CN: 通过已声明的认证能力创建读取云产品与 DP、同步并读回验证；不自动进入固件或面板发布。

tuyaopen-miniapp.en: Create, implement, build and preview a panel; upload/review/publish/bind only through the endpoint requested.
tuyaopen-miniapp.zh-CN: 创建、开发、构建和预览面板，仅推进到用户要求的上传、提审、发布或绑定终点。

tuyaopen-miniapp-ray-common.en: Ray framework APIs, device context, lifecycle, routing and localization; specific Smart UI props belong to smart-ui.
tuyaopen-miniapp-ray-common.zh-CN: Ray 框架 API、设备上下文、生命周期、路由与国际化；Smart UI 具体组件属性归专项技能。

tuyaopen-miniapp-smart-ui.en: Choose and compose Smart UI components, verify props/events and diagnose component behavior in Ray panels.
tuyaopen-miniapp-smart-ui.zh-CN: 选择组合 Smart UI 组件，核实属性事件并诊断组件行为；不承担通用 PRD 或发布流程。

tuyaopen-miniapp-charts-library.en: Integrate chart cards, statistics sources and period/granularity controls for panel chart tasks.
tuyaopen-miniapp-charts-library.zh-CN: 面板图表库、统计数据源、场景卡片及周期粒度控件接入。

tuyaopen-miniapp-requirement-guide.en: Produce a panel PRD, requested template or requested chapter; never force a PRD before ordinary coding.
tuyaopen-miniapp-requirement-guide.zh-CN: 按明确请求编写小程序面板 PRD、模板或指定章节；不作为普通开发的强制前置步骤。

tuyaopen-miniapp-performance-ux-guard.en: Review and optimize measured performance, interaction states, accessibility and release quality; not every UI coding task.
tuyaopen-miniapp-performance-ux-guard.zh-CN: 审查优化性能、交互状态、可访问性与发布质量；不接管所有 UI 编码任务。

tuyaos-build.en: Build/clean TuyaOS apps and wire local.mk sources/includes; do not run TuyaOpen tos.py.
tuyaos-build.zh-CN: TuyaOS 应用编译清理及 local.mk 源码/头文件接入；不运行 TuyaOpen tos.py。

tuyaos-hardware-vibe-coding.en: Implement TuyaOS peripherals using APIs evidenced in the active SDK and integrate the active app.
tuyaos-hardware-vibe-coding.zh-CN: 按当前 SDK 有据可查的 TAL/TKL API 实现 TuyaOS 外设并接入当前 APP。
